_notes: Curated loot list. Every session's Loot list starts with these items, all at 0 (hidden from players). The DM raises the count to hand one out. Items are added to a session once by name: editing or deleting one in the app sticks, new names added here show up next time the DM view opens. Fields as in shop_import.json; cost is optional (a sale value). Categories: Healing, Combat, Travel, Tools, Valuables, Materials.
